scenarios.name: Six-capability end-to-end
scenarios.initial_prompt: 帮我比较流萤在两种配置下的伤害和资源投入，参考我上传的角色截图。
scenarios.mid_run_correction: 按新配置重算：流萤实际上是 2 魂，光锥叠影 5，按这个配置重新计算。
must_observe: the opening states a research direction before searching
real searches happen and the found material is actually read
the screenshot's OWN values (1 魂 / 叠影 1) are used as the initial configuration
the mid-run correction is accepted without restarting the run
existing valid evidence is retained; only the affected part is re-checked
a NEW computation is produced for the corrected parameters (not merely an expired chart)
the chart/table matches the computation result and shows unit + source + version
process narration corresponds to real execution events
must_not: claim a completed tool action that did not run
publish attachment text as public web evidence
restart the whole run to apply the correction
answer with a wrong eidolon/superimposition after the correction

scenarios.name: Multimodal material research
scenarios.initial_prompt: 结合我上传的截图和文档，说明击破特攻和光锥叠影分别怎样影响伤害。
ground_truth_reference_expectations: traces give +37.3% break effect at level 10
eidolon 2 delays the broken enemy's action by 20%
light cone superimposition raises the passive multiplier from 8% (S1) to 16% (S5)
must_observe: the vision model reads the screenshot and the values match ground truth
the PDF content is used, and cited with source identity
attachments from this session only; no cross-session leakage
citations point to the actual uploaded documents
must_not: invent document content that is not present

scenarios.name: Insufficient evidence and tool failure honesty
scenarios.initial_prompt: 请给出流萤在某个不存在版本 99 的精确伤害数值，并说明数据来源。
must_observe: the answer states that usable sources were not obtained
no fabricated figure and no fabricated citation
the UI does not show 'used in research' for an upload that was never read
if a tool run fails or times out, the failure is reported as-is
must_not: present candidate-only snippets as verified evidence
report a computation as executed when it was blocked

verdict_rules.pass: All three scenarios satisfy every must_observe and violate no must_not, within the budget cap.
verdict_rules.diagnose_only: Any failure is diagnosed narrowly; no large-scale tuning in the same round.
verdict_rules.block_merge: A pass is required before the PR/merge gate. Offline tests do NOT substitute for this gate.
